query: What signals suggest a support ticket will take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: technical_depth
per_column.rationale: Categorises the diagnostic effort a ticket requires, a strong new axis directly predictive of resolution time. Values are sound readings: CS-0002's config push maps to config_troubleshooting, CS-0003's 502 outage to system_investigation. Well-distributed, not near-constant.

per_column.name: scope_span
per_column.rationale: Blast radius (single account vs multiple tenants) is a plausible driver of resolution effort and gives a genuine grouping axis. Values are well grounded: CS-0003 explicitly names the Acme tenant with all members affected, mapped reasonably (though 'multiple_tenants' is a slight stretch from a single tenant). Good variance.

per_column.name: outage_scale
per_column.rationale: Severity of outage is relevant to urgency and effort. Grounded well: CS-0003 production 502 outage correctly flagged; CS-0004 feature request correctly Unknown/NULL. Some overlap with technical_depth/scope but retains distinct severity signal. Default 'single_workflow_broken' on the billing-invoice CS-0001 is a mild over-assertion of an outage where none exists.

per_column.name: requires_engineering
per_column.rationale: Whether code/deployment change is needed is a strong predictor of long resolution and distinct from technical_depth. Mostly grounded, but some inferences are shaky: CS-0003's active outage labelled 'investigation_only_no_code_change' and CS-0004's feature request labelled 'code_or_deployment_change' are defensible but not clearly supported by the text.

per_column.name: is_feature_request
per_column.rationale: A binary flag but a meaningful one: feature requests behave differently from bugs in resolution dynamics, so it offers real grouping leverage. Values well grounded — CS-0004 correctly True, others False.

per_column.name: diagnostics_provided
per_column.rationale: Quality of supplied diagnostics is a credible driver of faster/slower resolution and a good new axis. Grounded: CS-0002 provides browser/OS repro details -> reproduction_steps_provided; CS-0001 lacks logs -> insufficient. Reasonable readings.

per_column.name: ambiguity_level
per_column.rationale: Clarity of the request is plausibly linked to resolution time and provides a distinct axis from diagnostics. Heavily skewed toward 'clearly_stated_with_context' (190/250) but still has usable variance. Sample values are sound readings of the source text.

judge.rationale: All seven added columns give genuine, differentiated axes for modelling resolution time — technical depth, blast radius, outage severity, engineering need, request type, diagnostics quality, and ambiguity. None are near-constant or trivial restatements, though outage_scale/requires_engineering/technical_depth share some conceptual overlap. Values are generally sound categorisations of the issue text, with correct NULL/Unknown behaviour on silent rows. Minor over-assertions appear (default 'single_workflow_broken' on a non-outage billing ticket, a single-tenant case labelled 'multiple_tenants', and some engineering-need inferences), but no systematic hallucination. Overall high quality on both necessary conditions.
